title: Shop
description: REOSERV data/pub/shops/<id>.json — one ShopRecord per file. See src/utils/load_shop_file.rs.

x-aio-groups.label: Rarity
x-aio-groups.description: Optional per-shop rarity distribution for this shop's generic (unpinned) instanced stock. Leave the whole object absent → the shop sells Common baseline gear. An item's own preset_rarity pin still wins. Numbers should sum to 1.0.

behavior_id.description: Behavior id wired to a shopkeeper NPC.

rarity_weights.title: Rarity weights
rarity_weights.description: Per-shop rarity distribution for generic instanced stock. Absent → Common. A base item's preset_rarity overrides this. Numbers should sum to 1.0; a partial object is ignored (server falls back to Common).

common.title: Common
common.description: Probability of a common item (1 mod slot).

rare.title: Rare
rare.description: Probability of a rare item (2 mod slots).

epic.title: Epic
epic.description: Probability of an epic item (3 mod slots).

legendary.title: Legendary
legendary.description: Probability of a legendary item (4 mod slots).

buy_price.description: Gold the shop pays to buy from the player. 0 = won't buy.

sell_price.description: Gold the shop charges to sell to the player. 0 = not for sale.

crafts.description: Craft recipes available at the shop. Empty = no crafting.
